title: Singular traveling waves for the Euler-Poisson system
summary: We consider the Euler-Poisson system for ions where the electrons are given by a Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, and we investigate the existence of one-dimensional periodic traveling waves. More precisely, we first establish the existence of a smooth global branch of bifurcation emanating from a constant equilibrium. We then construct a singular traveling wave emerging as the limiting profile at the end of the global curve of bifurcation. Our analysis accommodates a wide class of pressure laws and provides a comprehensive characterization of both smooth and singular traveling waves. A…
